svg.data-asic: Broadcom Jericho2 BCM88690 with Broadcom OP2 BCM16K external TCAM
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO with optional holdover; SyncE (ITU-T); IEEE 1588v2 default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 (additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC; Time Sensitive Networking (TSN); Class C timing accuracy. NOS integration is required to activate these, which the datasheet states with an asterisk against the whole timing block
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-coherent: 400G ZR and OpenZR+ on the six 100/400G QSFP-DD, OpenZR+ on the eight 40/100G QSFP-DD - the capability the platform is named for
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G on the two SFP+ management ports. The datasheet's Compatible Transceiver Types list names QSFP-DD, QSFP56 and QSFP28 optics only and no SFP+ part at all, so the speed here is the port list's ('2 x 10G SFP+ management ports') and no specific module is claimed for it
svg.data-compliance-programme: IEEE 802.1CM fronthaul; ITU-T G.8273.2 T-BC Class C
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in; 1PPS SMB in/out; 10MHz SMB in/out; ToD RJ45 in/out; BITS RJ48 in/out
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 62479; EN 50663; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A

circle.data-description: Present in HIG Figure 7 and given no table anywhere in this guide, so the states are the component default rather than a vocabulary borrowed from another platform
